Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Tall or slight identity must read through shape and posture without shrinking the head below the required chibi ratio.

Hair continuity: blonde-gold bun-topknot-wrapped; accent: wrapped contrasting band. Preserve the front and side silhouette of bun-topknot-wrapped, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and wrapped contrasting band; color remains blonde-gold. Condition: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale.
